نَابِضٌ [part. n. of 1]. You say, مَا دَامَ فِىَّ عُرَيْقٌ نَابِضٌ لَمْ أَخْذُلْكَ [As long as there remains in me a little artery pulsing, I will not abstain, or hold back, from aiding thee]; i. e., (tropical:) as long as I remain alive. (A, TA.) ―
-b2- [Hence,] (tropical:) Anger. (Lth, A, K.) See 1, where an ex. is given. ―
-b3- (assumed tropical:) An archer: lit. one who has a twanging. (Mgh.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
